'''Lorenzo''' is an [[NPC]] that first appears in {{Quest|The Best Audience}} and a member of the [[Troupe of Fools]].

== Profile ==
Lorenzo was exiled by the [[Order of the Deep|Order]] and sent on the [[Pilgrim's Sail]] and never returned to his family, instead staying with the Troupe of Fools. During the Troupe's off-seasons he visits his home, [[Egla Town]], and has become known by the town's people as the "Drama Maniac", a person who dons a mask to share stories about the adventures of the [[Troupe of Fools]]. His niece, [[Batti]], and nephew, [[Leto]], often listen to the stories he tells.

He's often accompanied by [[Chalulu]], a [[Lottie Lost]] [[Common Echo]].
